name: Gasthof Stiegl
kurzbeschreibung:
**The Stiegl Inn in Mieming**

Welcome to **Gasthof Stiegl**, a cozy retreat nestled in the heart of **Mieming**, a charming village in the **Tirol** Alps. Here, tradition meets warmth in every corner.

Our rustic yet inviting rooms offer a perfect blend of comfort and alpine charm, ensuring you feel right at home. After a day of exploring the breathtaking landscapes, unwind with a hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, a crisp **Tiroler Bier**, or a slice of our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**—served with a dollop of apricot jam, of course.

Outdoor enthusiasts will love the proximity to hiking trails, ski slopes, and the serene waters of **Achensee**. Whether you're seeking adventure or relaxation, **Gasthof Stiegl** is your ideal base for an unforgettable stay in the **Tirol** countryside.

Come experience the authentic hospitality of the **Tirol** Alps—where every visit feels like coming home.
